findings.reason: Confirmed (high). Items 099 and 121 write the quotient as W_rΩ^m_R/dV^{r−1}Ω^m_R. In arXiv v2, p. 55, equations (26)–(27) print the same, as page-image checks confirm. But d raises degree, so dV^{r−1}Ω^m lies in degree m + 1 and is not a subgroup of W_rΩ^m. The intended quotient is W_rΩ^m_R/dV^{r−1}Ω^{m−1}_R. The r = 1 formula immediately above, ν̃^m(R) = coker(1 − C^{−1}: Ω^m_R → Ω^m_R/dΩ^{m−1}_R), has this form. The red team also cites Morrow's Corollary 4.2, which has W_rΩ^n_A/dV^{r−1}Ω^{n−1}_A; I did not re-read Morrow's paper. The fix is right: correct both items and record a misprint sourceIssue.

Confirmed (medium). Item 038 (nonunital R-algebras, the equivalence with augmented algebras via R ⋉ I) is 'missing' as a whole. At the pinned Mathlib the algebraic part exists. NonUnitalAlgHom is defined at Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/NonUnitalHom.lean:57. In Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Unitization.lean, `structure Unitization (R A : Type*) extends R × A` is at line 68, `def fstHom : Unitization R A →ₐ[R] R` at line 660, and `def inrNonUnitalAlgHom` at line 675. The same file has `def lift : (A →ₙₐ[R] C) ≃ (Unitization R A →ₐ[R] C)`, the universal property, at line 766. The fix is right: split the item, mark the existing data 'library', and keep the categorical equivalence, the limits and colimits and the henselian theory missing.

Confirmed (medium). Definition 5.14 (arXiv v2, pp. 42–43) says a tower is almost nilpotent 'if for each n ∈ Z, the truncated tower {τ_{≤n}X_i} is nilpotent, or equivalently if each tower {π_n(X_i)} of abelian groups is nilpotent'. The next sentence adds the qualifier 'If the tower is uniformly bounded below' only for the quickly converging variant. Without such a bound the 'equivalently' is false. In X_i = ⊕_{j≥i} Σ^{−j}HF_p with tail inclusions, each homotopy tower {π_{−j}X_i} is nilpotent, but τ_{≤0}X_i = X_i and no single N kills X_{i+N} → X_i. The fix is right: add a sourceIssue and keep item 091's truncation definition.

Confirmed; I would grade it low. The proof of Theorem 5.21 (p. 44) reads 'By Theorem 4.36 we see K^inv(R) = K^inv(R ⊗_{HZ} HZ/p^iZ)', although the conclusion needed and supplied is modulo p. The proof of Corollary 5.33 (p. 49) says the surjection {K_n(R/I^s)}_s → {K_n(R/I^s; Z/p)}_s 'is an isomorphism'. For R = F_p, I = 0 and n = 0 that map is ℤ → ℤ/p. Only the quotient by p is an isomorphism, together with the vanishing of {K_{n−1}(R/I^s)[p]}_s. Both slips are in proofs and leave the stated theorems intact, so recording them as misprints is right, but they are presentation-level.
